snippet.title: BlazBlue Entropy Effect x Dead Cells: Official Crossover DLC Trailer
snippet.description:
The Prisoner from Dead Cells, along with newly playable character Bullet, join BlazBlue Entropy Effect for a crossover DLC event. This DLC also adds a two-player couch co-op mode. It drops on September 1. 

Check it out on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/51545/Dead_Cells_x_BlazBlue_Entropy_Effect/
